title: Three years at Condon's and the Sky Club offer
summary: Hackett vouches for him; he stays three years and then goes to Chicago's Sky Club with Scarsdale kids.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: So, uh, Bill Davis' wife run up, and when she found out, she says, oh, my Bill's got to work with Brunus. So, uh, Bobby Hackett was staying at the bar, and we were talking Condon, Pesky, and so Condon says, well, he says, I got to do something I never did in my life. I hate to do it. I got to fire two guys. I think it was Brad Gowns and, uh, Max Kaminsky. So, uh, he says, I got to put Barnum and Bailey in there. So Bobby Hackett says, look, no matter who you're putting in, as long as you do business, he says, Brunus can do business. I'll pay for you. So I went in, I stayed there three years, and I run up a tab, I think, of $1,200. Hey! So, uh, then I got an offer to go out to, come out here to Chicago to, uh, the Sky Club. It wasn't much, it was a nice place, but they never advertised, and I had, uh, the, uh, high school kids, uh, what's the name of the high school? I had, uh, Scarsdale High School kids.
